Zhao He transmigrated into a world of cultivation, but without any powers! So staying safe became his mantra! But while staying safe by hiding in the grass, he became possessed by the soul of the former Demon Lord, and now two souls will have to share one body! Lacking spiritual power, the Demon Lord forcibly used his body to cultivates demonic powers, breaking through to the next level. Lacking resources for further cultivation, the Demon Lord forcibly seized the treasures. Lacking a companion, the Demon Lord kidnapped the high priestess of the demonic sect to become his cultivation partner. All Zhao He could say to that was, "I must be a great guy to be so helpful!"

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

149004.description:

149005.description:
All things have spiritual power. Those who have the talent can absorb the qi of heaven and earth, yin and yang, and strengthen their own spiritual body. They can use their spiritual talent, in combination with energy of yuan-yang or yuan-yin, to shape the power of heaven and earth, which is the art of spiritual cultivation. Wang Ze, the only heir of the Wang family bloodline, has a very strong talent for spiritual cultivation. Under the guidance of his grandfather, his power awakened as he entered the spiritual world...

While setting up the virtual lover dating game, he accidentally generated a male lover for himself. He was embarrassed at first, but when he uploaded the video, it unexpectedly went viral...

(Source: Dongman Manhua, translated)

149008.description:
Ye Wuyou transmigrated into a fantasy world, only to find himself with no support, no talent, and no luck, stuck with a job as a worthless street-sweeper. He thought he'll just live a quiet life, until he was suddenly blessed with the God-Tier Luck System. A few years later, Ye Wuyou looked back to find himself on the top of the world, known as the luckiest man alive!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Liszt, a programmer of the game "Miracle," agreed to entered the game world to play the role of the final boss "Dark Lord," to help cure his mother's illness. The contract agreement stated Liszt must stay in the game world until he was defeated by the players. But the the stats of the Dark Lord were too high, and what was suppose to be an easy fight to beat Lizst became a reverse slaughter for him instead. He slowly realized that if he wanted to be successfully defeated and return to the real world, he'll have to try some different strategies…

Medea, the witch novelist, was about to die from staying up late writing too often. Before her death, she specially tailored a novel for herself, intending to transmigrate into the book to live a perfectly scripted life. But — her perfect loving prince became a perverted killer; her loyal knight became a misogynistic homosexual; and her doting older brother became the villain's lapdog. She was supposed to be the perfect heroine, but she became the evil villainess instead! In order to survive, Medea had to marry… no, form an alliance… with the despised Demon Lord!

Nan Gonghua is a special agent on the hunt for a mad scientist and "deeds", artifacts with supernatural powers. While on a mission, he strayed into an alternate universe of beast-men. Stumbling and bumbling, the young man gradually unraveled the mystery of his origins, gained the power of the ancients, and finally opened the portal to another world, not realizing that the other world was the true source of darkness! 149092.description:
Perhaps karma does exist. Han Nokyoung, an A-list actor with a foul attitude, winds up getting his just deserts when a video of him sleeping with LK Entertainment’s CEO, Kang Junil, surfaces on the internet. To make matters worse, Nokyoung soon becomes the victim of an acid attack, ending his career entirely. With even his boss and the man he loves, Jang Hyunjae, leaving his side, Nokyoung feels there’s nothing left for him anymore and takes his own life. But instead of waking up in the afterlife, Nokyoung finds himself three years in the past! Now determined to change the future, Nokyoung turns over a new leaf and tries not to get involved with either of the men that led to his downfall. However, when it comes to Kang Junil, Nokyoung’s fate might already be sealed…

(Source: Tappytoon)

What no one expects is for Julius to call off the engagement, claiming that Philia’s perfection makes her charmless and unlikable. To add insult to injury, Philia is packed off to a neighboring country in exchange for gold and resources, forcing her to leave her homeland! Despite bracing herself for mistreatment, Philia finds a warm welcome in her new town, where she puts her saintly abilities to good use erecting barriers against monsters and curing epidemics. But even as she flourishes in her new life, her homeland is under threat of destruction!

This is a prescription for a little laughter and hope for those of you who are angry or saddened by the mess that has been created by the Ordinance. How did this happen, why is this happening, and what can we do about it?

But is there a reason behind this old woman's unkind demeanour?
3. Ookina Ie no Ojou-san (大きな家のお嬢さん)

4. Obaachan to Mama to Papa (おばあちゃんとママとパパ)
Set in Japan and follows the girl Marie. Marie and her divorced mother live together with a conservative grandmother who has been pushing old fashioned ideals of what an ideal girl and woman is onto Marie.
5. Hajimari no Hi (はじまりの日)
Set in Afghanistan in 2002 after the Taliban first lost power. We follow two girls as they receive school supplies for the first time.

149850.description:
PeopIe have never been kind about Mikiko's looks. ln an effort to change that, she gets plastic surgery and transforms into a woman of unrivaled beauty, but is killed in an accident the same day. She wakes up in the Tang Dynasty of ancient times, taking over the life of legendary concubine, Yang Guifei, who had just been assassinated by Consort Wu Huifei, a villain who intends to make herself and the emperor's son, Shou Wang, successors to the throne. Yang Guifei was later named one Of the Three Beauties of the World and in historical fact, although she was once married to Shou Wang, Yang Guifei becomes Emperor Xuanzong's beloved consort. However, Mikiko, who replaces Yang Guifei, finds herself confronting the power struggles of the inner palace and the hidden romance between her and the "fake emperor" Shou Wang, something buried in the depths of history.

1. Nazuna yo Nazuna (なずなよ なずな, 6 chapters)
Momo, a second-year student at Sakuraen High School, was molested on the bus on her way to school and lost her student ID. Momo's best friend, Yomogi, also lost a book on child-rearing that she was supposed to show Momo on that bus. On that same day, a handsome boy named Serina Nazuna transferred into her class. Momo thought that he was the culprit and tried to confront him, but when she followed Nazuna to his house, she found that Nazuna was raising a younger sister and four younger brothers. He told her that he only took Momo's ID in order to verify her name and face, and took the book because he wanted to free his family from his cold-blooded father, in whose house he now lives.
